summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi revealed that Israeli and US strikes on Iran targeted senior leadership including Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei's office, resulting in multiple casualties among top officials. The attacks occurred on 9 Esfand 1404 (January 9, 2024) as part of a coordinated operation involving multiple locations in Tehran. Israel's military confirmed killing senior Iranian intelligence officials including Sadr al-Din al-Husayni, while Iran reported casualties among its highest-ranking officials.

sections.executive_summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi revealed that Israeli and US strikes targeted Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei's office, killing Khamenei and several senior military officials in what he described as a 'security well' operation. The attacks occurred on 9 Esfand 1404 (January 9, 2024) as part of a coordinated operation involving multiple locations in Tehran. Israel's military confirmed killing senior Iranian intelligence officials including Sadr al-Din al-Husayni, while Iran reported casualties among its highest-ranking officials.

points: Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi revealed that Israeli and US strikes on January 9 targeted multiple locations in Tehran including the Supreme Leader's office, killing Ali Khamenei and senior military officials. He stated that a 'security well' operation was used and that only Ali Ashgar Hajazi survived among the targeted security officials. (Source: @VahidOnline/77274)

Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi revealed that the January 9 strikes also targeted the offices of Ali Shamkhani and Mohammad Shirazi, two senior military officials, along with security official Ali Ashgar Hajazi who was the only survivor. He also mentioned a meeting of the Supreme National Security Council's defense committee that was also targeted. (Source: @VahidOnline/77274)

sections.threat_assessment: The conflict has escalated to direct strikes on Iran's highest leadership, including the Supreme Leader, indicating a significant expansion of hostilities beyond previous proxy and border conflicts. Israeli and US coordination in targeting Iranian leadership suggests a strategic shift toward direct action against Iran's core institutions. The targeting of Hamas commanders and Kurdish opposition positions indicates a broader regional escalation involving multiple actors and theaters. Iranian retaliation through missile launches toward Jordan and Iraq demonstrates the potential for further regional spillover effects. The confirmed killing of senior Iranian officials and the survival of only one security official among the targeted officials indicates the high lethality of the strikes.
sections.regional_response: Jordan has evacuated populations near Aqaba following Iranian missile launches, indicating regional concern about spillover effects. Kuwait has activated its air defenses in response to reported missile and drone attacks, demonstrating the broader Gulf region's vulnerability to escalation. The targeting of Erbil in northern Iraq shows the conflict's expansion into Iraqi territory, potentially drawing Iraq into the confrontation. Israeli military has placed forces on high alert and prepared for immediate return to combat operations in Judea and Samaria, indicating preparation for further escalation. The coordination between Israeli and US forces in targeting Iranian leadership suggests a unified Western response to Iranian activities.
sections.intelligence_notes: Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi's public revelations about the targeting of Supreme Leader Khamenei's office provide unprecedented insight into the scope and coordination of Israeli-US strikes on Iran's leadership. The confirmation of multiple senior Iranian casualties, including military and security officials, indicates the strikes achieved significant strategic objectives. The survival of only one security official among the targeted officials suggests the high precision and lethality of the operations. Israeli intelligence reports of Iranian plans to target Israeli figures in Tel Aviv indicate ongoing Iranian retaliatory planning. The simultaneous missile launches from Iran toward Jordan and Kuwait's defense against attacks suggest coordinated Iranian response efforts.
